shots.chapter: From the fire pixel to the clinic queue

captions.text: A five-day haze outlook for *every district and clinic*.
captions.sub: On a real 3D globe: NASA imagery · NASA FIRMS fires · Copernicus CAMS smoke · open data only

captions.text: Kalimantan: 56 districts, *339 mapped puskesmas*.
captions.sub: Districts: geoBoundaries · puskesmas: OpenStreetMap

captions.text: October 2026, *replayed day by day*.
captions.sub: Smoke: Copernicus CAMS PM2.5 (archive) · fires: NASA FIRMS VIIRS NOAA-20

captions.text: Haze day: PM10 ≥ 100 µg/m³. With a satellite fire: *fire-haze day*.
captions.sub: Definitions from a puskesmas study in Central Kalimantan (Phung et al. 2025, Int J Epidemiol)

captions.text: Pillars: *expected respiratory visits* at each puskesmas.
captions.sub: Taller = more visits · colour = change from a normal day

captions.text: Where should posko and oxygen houses *open first*?
captions.sub: Districts ranked by the expected change in respiratory visits

captions.text: Pulang Pisau: *+88%* respiratory visits expected.
captions.sub: 95% range +14% to +211% · mean over 14–18 Oct 2026

captions.text: A fire-haze day, *28 days in a row*.
captions.sub: The study's effect grows with the length of the haze

captions.text: The study's *limits* stay next to the numbers.
captions.sub: One study, six puskesmas, 2015–2019 · applied by analogy outside Central Kalimantan

captions.text: Click a pillar: *one puskesmas*.
captions.sub: The camera glides in and leaves room for the panel

captions.text: Puskesmas Jabiren, 14 Oct: *4.7* respiratory visits a day expected.
captions.sub: 95% range 2.8 to 7.8 · usual 2.5 (study default, editable by the puskesmas)

captions.text: Plan a *clean-air waiting room*.
captions.sub: Corsi–Rosenthal box preset from a US EPA test (Holder et al. 2022)

captions.text: And how smoky the room gets, *with and without a cleaner*.
captions.sub: Measured smoke infiltration (Barn et al. 2008) · not a 95% interval, and the app says so

captions.text: One button: a briefing the health office can *send as is*.
captions.sub: Copy, WhatsApp, download, print · in English or Bahasa Indonesia

captions.text: Written by the *Rust engine*, not a language model.
captions.sub: So no range, data time, failed source or limit gets lost

captions.text: *Sumatra* too: Riau, Jambi, South Sumatra.
captions.sub: Regions are data packs: 40 more districts, the same engine

captions.text: What did the forecast say *at 06:00 that morning*?
captions.sub: The CAMS run available that morning, from the Copernicus Atmosphere Data Store

captions.text: The app *checks itself*: haze days caught, missed, raised falsely.
captions.sub: Forecast against the model's later estimate, not stations · and the app says so

captions.text: *Spec-driven*: requirements, design decisions, tasks.
captions.sub: {specCounts}

captions.text: Steering sets the house rules. *Hooks* check every edit against them.
captions.sub: They fire on Kiro's own edits too, and caught real bugs before they shipped

captions.text: *Property-based tests*, and one engine everywhere.
captions.sub: Browser (WebAssembly) and agent (native CLI) give byte-identical output

captions.text: Kiro gets the *same engine* as MCP tools.
captions.sub: 7 tools, a custom briefing agent, a Kiro power · shown: the real output of daily_brief for 14 Oct

captions.text: The same night from space: *the fires and the cities*.
captions.sub: NASA VIIRS Day/Night Band, 14 Oct 2026 · the app's night layer

captions.text: Live: *the next five days*, every morning.
captions.sub: {liveNote}
